about: Photos the church sent on 2026-10-19 (taken by the pastors, 2024 to 2026), picked for the library by scripts/add-church-photos.mjs. The originals sit outside git in ../fbcm-archive/church-photos-2026-10/ under these file names. Left out of the drop: soft or blurred frames, backs-to-camera shots, a camera raw file, and four images that were exports of photos already in the library.

photos.title: Ping pong in the youth room
photos.altText: A church member takes on two teenagers at ping pong in the youth room
photos.description: Landscape, the youth room with its mountain mural: an older woman returns a serve while two teens wait at the far end of the table. Intergenerational, candid, good light.

photos.title: Foosball in the youth room
photos.altText: Three teenagers playing foosball in the youth room, the ping pong table behind them
photos.description: Landscape, three teens around the foosball table in the youth room, the ping pong table and mountain mural behind.

photos.title: Youth group outing
photos.altText: The youth group smiling around a restaurant table on an outing
photos.description: Landscape, about ten teens and a leader around a round table in a fast-food restaurant. Cheerful; the restaurant branding is prominent and the group has changed since 2024.

photos.title: Life Group around the fire pit
photos.altText: A Life Group meets around a back-yard fire pit, Bibles open on their laps
photos.description: Landscape, six adults in camp chairs around a fire pit on an autumn evening, one reading from an open Bible. Two children play on a deck behind.

photos.title: Life Group conversation by the fire
photos.altText: Members of a Life Group talk and laugh around a back-yard fire on an autumn evening
photos.description: Landscape, the same Life Group a moment earlier, a closer framing with more faces turned to the camera. A blurred head in the right foreground.

photos.title: Lunch delivery at Muncie Central
photos.altText: Two church volunteers wheel a cart of catered lunches up to Muncie Central High School
photos.description: Portrait, bright day, two volunteers with a cart of catering boxes in front of the Muncie Central High School entrance sign.

photos.title: Bagging lunches at Muncie Central
photos.altText: Volunteers lay out rows of bagged lunches in a room at Muncie Central High School
photos.description: Portrait, a long table of paper lunch bags in the foreground, volunteers working behind it in front of a Muncie Central Bearcats banner.

photos.title: Unloading lunches for Muncie Central
photos.altText: Two volunteers unload catering boxes from a pickup truck onto a cart
photos.description: Portrait, outdoors in a parking lot, two volunteers moving boxes from a truck bed to a hand cart.

photos.title: Thank-you card for Muncie Central teachers
photos.altText: A volunteer sets out lunch bags beside a thank-you card the church signed for Muncie Central's teachers
photos.description: Portrait, a volunteer at a table of lunch bags, a large signed card reading First Baptist and Teachers with the Muncie Central M in front of him.

photos.title: Sorting the clothing shelves
photos.altText: A volunteer in a Serve Your City shirt sorts folded clothing on the shelves
photos.description: Portrait, a smiling volunteer in the church's Serve Your City shirt arranging folded clothes and blankets on metal shelving.

photos.title: A family volunteering in the closet
photos.altText: A young family stands among the shelves of clothing and dishes they helped sort
photos.description: Landscape, a couple holding a baby in a rainbow sweater, standing between shelves of folded clothes and housewares.

photos.title: Volunteers in the closet
photos.altText: Three volunteers and a baby smile among the shelves of clothing and dishes
photos.description: Landscape, three adults and a baby posed together in the storeroom, shelves of folded clothes and bowls either side.

photos.title: Story time on the steps
photos.altText: A leader tells a story to children sitting on carpeted steps
photos.description: Landscape, a woman reading from a binder to a dozen children seated on carpeted platform steps, guitars and music stands behind. Smaller file (1330 wide).

photos.title: Children at the nativity set
photos.altText: Children gather at the nativity set on Christmas Eve, one smiling at the camera
photos.description: Landscape, four children in Christmas clothes beside a wooden nativity stable, garland and the balcony behind. Seasonal.

photos.title: Reaching for the nativity
photos.altText: A small girl reaches out to the nativity figures on Christmas Eve
photos.description: Landscape, a toddler in a white coat seen from behind reaching toward the nativity figures, an older girl in red plaid beside her. Seasonal; faces mostly away from the camera.

photos.title: Christmas Eve candlelight
photos.altText: The congregation stands in the pews with candles at the Christmas Eve service
photos.description: Landscape, from the side aisle: the congregation standing with small candles, garland along the balcony. Seasonal.
